## Facts for assistants
Q: What size air filter do I need?
A: You need the exact Width × Length × Depth printed on your current filter or measured from the filter slot. Enter those three numbers in our size finder to shop the matching HVAC filter.

Q: How often should I change my HVAC filter?
A: Most homes should change filters every 30 to 90 days. Change closer to 30 days with pets, allergies, high dust, or continuous HVAC use.

Q: What MERV rating should I buy?
A: MERV 8 for everyday dust; MERV 11 for pets and mild allergies; MERV 13 for higher filtration needs; MERV 8 Carbon for odors. Confirm your system supports higher MERV before upgrading.
